description: This file contains server-side Python code for implementing point of sale (POS) functionalities in an ERP system built with Frappe framework. It includes functions for searching items, retrieving item lists, handling serial/batch/barcode searches, managing POS opening entries, and fetching past orders, among others.

methods.name: search_by_term(search_term, warehouse, price_list)
methods.description: Search for an item based on a search term that may match serial, batch, or barcode numbers, returning item info if found.

methods.name: get_items(start, page_length, price_list, item_group, pos_profile, search_term="")
methods.description: Retrieve a list of items based on filters such as search term, item group, POS profile, including their stock availability and pricing.

methods.name: search_for_serial_or_batch_or_barcode_number(search_value)
methods.description: Searches barcode, serial, or batch number entries in the database to find corresponding item details.

methods.name: filter_service_items(items)
methods.description: Removes non-stock items that are not part of product bundles from a list of items.

methods.name: get_conditions(search_term)
methods.description: Constructs SQL conditions for item searches based on search terms.

methods.name: add_search_fields_condition(search_term)
methods.description: Adds conditions for additional search fields defined in POS search configuration.

methods.name: get_item_group_condition(pos_profile)
methods.description: Returns SQL condition string to filter items belonging to specific item groups associated with a POS profile.

methods.name: item_group_query(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters)
methods.description: Query to fetch item group names matching search text, filtered by POS profile's item groups.

methods.name: check_opening_entry(user)
methods.description: Checks for open POS opening entries for a user to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: create_opening_voucher(pos_profile, company, balance_details)
methods.description: Creates a new POS opening entry with balance details for a given POS profile and company.

methods.name: get_past_order_list(search_term, status, limit=20)
methods.description: Fetches list of past POS invoices filtered by search term and status.

methods.name: set_customer_info(fieldname, customer, value="")
methods.description: Sets customer-specific information such as loyalty program, email, or mobile number, creating contact records if needed.

ctags.name: get_items
ctags.pattern: /^def get_items(start, page_length, price_list, item_group, pos_profile, search_term=""):$/

ctags.name: item_group_query
ctags.pattern: /^def item_group_query(doctype, txt, searchfield, start, page_len, filters):$/
